item.name: Anti-impetum Robe
entries: The fabric pulls gently against sudden motion, as if urging caution.
You have 15 AC against melee attacks. When a melee attack misses you, roll damage for that attack anyway and gain that many Temporary Hit Points.

item.name: Amulet of Cutting Missiles
entries: Mages recognize the Amulet of Cutting Missiles by the faint sparks that dance across its setting.
You can cast {@spell Magic Missile} at its lowest level once per day without expending a spell slot. Each of your Magic Missile darts do +1 additional Force damage.

item.name: Amulet of Rejuvenation
entries: This amulet beats faintly like a second pulse against the chest.
You can cast {@spell Healing Word} at its lowest level once per day without expending a spell slot. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

item.name: Arcane Conduit Staff
entries: Polished and regal, it carries the strange confidence of a ruler who claims kindness and victory alike.

This {@item +1 Quarterstaff} lets you channel magical energies through your allies. Any spell that can be cast from your position can instead be cast from the position of a willing ally or friendly creature within 60 feet of you.

item.name: Argaz's Circus Sash
entries: This brightly colored sash flies impressively behind its wearer's tumbling and springing.

Add your Proficiency Bonus to Acrobatics checks. If you are already proficient in {@skill Acrobatics}, add your Proficiency Bonus a second time. As a Bonus action, you can roll an {@skill Acrobatics} check DC 20 to ignore {@quickref difficult terrain||3} and move along vertical surfaces as if they are horizontal until the end of turn.

item.name: Armor of Many Pelts
entries: Layers of fur whisper of a hundred beasts that once ruled the wild.
This Hide Armor grants +1 to the wearer's Armor Class even while in Wild Shape forms. You also gain +1 to your Spell Save DC and one additional use of Wild Shape per day.

item.name: Barroom Hustler Dart
entries: Light, balanced, and clearly thrown by someone who never planned to lose the wager.

This {@item Dart|PHB} deals {@damage 1d4} Force damage and always hits its target. The {@item Dart|PHB} disappears on impact to reappear in your hand. Attacks with this weapon cannot have their damage increased by any means.

item.name: Blade of the Warden
entries: Its steady edge reflects the calm resolve of one who never abandons their post.
This {@item +1 Longsword} defends its user. As a Reaction, you can parry a melee attack and gain +2 AC against that attack.

item.name: Blinding Buckler
entries: A sudden flash from its mirrored face leaves foes grasping at empty air.
As a Bonus action, you can cast {@spell Color Spray} with a spell save DC of 15 once per day without expending a spell slot.

item.name: Bogle Egg Sac
entries: The lumpy sac pulses faintly, as though the mischief inside is already waiting to escape.

Once per day, as a ritual spell, you can pull one of the slimy eggs from this sac and throw it to the ground. It will immediately hatch into a {@creature bogle|RealmsBeyondTime}, who will follow your spoken commands.

item.name: Boots of the Early Mist
entries: The leather is always cool with dew, as if the dawn itself still walks beside you.
You can cast {@spell Misty Step} once per day without expending a spell slot.

item.name: Bow of Blasting
entries: When its string snaps taut, the air itself seems to flinch.

This {@item +1 Longbow} can fire normal ammunition, but when drawn empty it fires a shimmering arrow that deals {@dice 1d6} plus your Dexterity modifier Force damage. All creatures within 5 feet of the target also take {@damage 1d4} Force damage.

item.name: Corvid Glove
entries: Black leather feathers the wrist, and sometimes the glove seems to move on its own.

You can cast {@spell Mage Hand} once per day. Whenever you cast {@spell Mage Hand}, both the range of Mage Hand and the movement of the hand are increased to 60 feet. You can roll {@skill Sleight of Hand} checks through the hand when you do so through this glove.

item.name: Courier's Cap
entries: Couriers travel without fear of robbery or inspection while wearing this well-worn peaked cap.
Contains an interdimensional space inside large enough for a single Small or Tiny object. Once per day, you can gain +10 feet to your Speed for up to 1 minute.

item.name: Brutal Sapper
entries: The spines of this {@item mace|PHB} are made from a dark, porous metal that seems to resent every blow that doesn't end the fight.
Enemies struck by this {@item Mace|PHB} cannot recover Hit Points until the beginning of your next turn.

item.name: Card Shark's Bracers
entries: The leather is worn smooth by a thousand strikes and just as many losing bets.
Gain Proficiency in Sleight of Hand. Your Dexterity is 14 while you wear these bracers. They have no effect on you if your Dexterity is already 14 or higher without them.

item.name: Chronomancer's Orb
entries: Within the glass, moments swirl like dust caught in slow light.

As a Bonus Action, you can return a target to its position prior to its most recent Move action. If that space is now occupied, the target appears in the nearest unoccupied space. You can use this ability once per day. This item can act as a Spellcasting Focus.

item.name: Eternal Promise Ring
entries: Its unbroken circle glows faintly, remembering a vow that time itself could not erase.
When you heal a creature, that creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your caster level.

item.name: Ember Light Band
entries: Hairline cracks across the Ember Light Band glow faintly like coals when battle begins.
Your weapon attacks also deal{@damage  + 1d4} Fire damage. You can cast the {@spell Light} cantrip at will.

item.name: Draconite Daggers
entries: Made from crystal beaten into a razor's edge, each {@item dagger|PHB} glitters with primeval energies.

This full set of +1 Daggers is sold separately. When you purchase a {@item dagger|PHB}, choose Necrotic, Lightning, Poison, Acid, Fire, or Cold damage. When you attack with this {@item dagger|PHB}, any weapon damage it deals can be replaced with that damage type and you gain Resistance to that damage type until the start of your next turn.

item.name: Curative Periapt
entries: This charm is warm and comforting to the touch to allow its wearer to rest and recover.
Whenever you are healed, you restore the maximum possible number of Hit Points.

item.name: Glaive of the Four Winds
entries: When it moves, the air stirs around the blade as if eager to take part in the battle.
This weapon acts as a {@item +1 Glaive}. Once per day, you can use an action to make an attack against any number of targets within a 10 foot radius of you.

item.name: Gloves of the Late Abbot
entries: The worn leather still carries the calm discipline of hands that once guided both prayer and punishment.
Your Unarmed Strikes do{@damage  + 1d4} Radiant damage. On a hit, recover 2 Hit Points.

item.name: Gorefiend Blade
entries: This jagged-edged weapon remembers every drop of blood it has ever claimed.
This {@item +1 Greatsword} does an additional {@damage 2d6} Slashing damage against targets with full HP. You gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the additional damage dealt in this way.

item.name: Glorious Light Shield
entries: Polished to a radiant sheen, it turns every defense into a moment of triumph.
Whenever an opponent makes a ranged or melee attack against you, they take Radiant damage equal to your

item.name: Gloves of the Undercity Brawler
entries: The cracked knuckles of these gloves have settled more arguments than words ever could.

When you make an Unarmed Strike or an attack while in a Wild Shape form, add your Proficiency Bonus to the attack and damage rolls of your first attack each turn. The gloves are considered a Simple Melee weapon with the Finesse and Light properties and deal {@damage 1d6} Bludgeoning damage.

item.name: Grakka's Warbow
entries: Modeled on the mythical bow wielded by the folk hero, Grakka, this massive bow is a sign of strength among nomadic peoples of the plains and steppes.
This {@item +1 Longbow} uses Strength instead of Dexterity for attack and damage rolls. If its user has 15 or more Strength, this bow suffers no penalties at long range.

item.name: Gnomish Grapplewhip
entries: A clever tangle of cord and clockwork that pulls you into the fray.

When this {@item whip|PHB} hits a target, you can attempt to Grapple it. The save DC for the grapple is 8 plus your Dexterity modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus. Inanimate objects automatically fail their saving throw. As long as a target is Grappled this way, you cannot use the Gnomish Grapplewhip for attacks but you can move to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target without consuming an action.

item.name: Gloves of the Twin Flame
entries: When worn together, faint warmth blooms in each palm, like two fires that refuse to burn alone.
Cantrips targeting foes or allies can target an additional creature. The same target cannot be chosen twice. Usable once per Short Rest.

item.name: Grim Breastplate
entries: Embossed with images of death, the dull steel saps your opponents' vitality to make it your own.
This {@item +1 Breastplate} allows you to smite your enemies with fell power. When you successfully hit a target with a melee attack, you can expend a spell slot to deal {@dice 2d4} additional
Necrotic damage. Using a spell slot higher than level 1 deals an additional {@damage 1d4} damage for each additional level.
You gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the additional damage dealt in this way.

item.name: Guile Stick
entries: A simple rod that somehow commands respect.

This weapon is treated as a {@item +2 Club} for weapon proficiency and masteries. Wielding this weapon grants +2 to {@skill Intimidation} checks. As a Bonus Action, you can attempt to frighten a creature within 30 feet. Roll an Intimidation check DC 20. If you succeed, that creature is Frightened until your next turn and you cannot use this ability again until after a Long Rest.

item.name: Hammer of Fissures
entries: Each swing promises to remind the earth how easily it can be broken.

This weapon is a {@item +1 Warhammer}. As an action, you can strike the ground at your feet and roll an attack roll against all targets within a 5 foot radius of you in contact with the ground. On a hit, deal {@dice 1d6} plus your Strength modifier Force damage.

item.name: Harbor Guard's Iron
entries: Salt-worn metal carries the steadfast patience of those who watch the tides.
This {@item +1 Half Plate Armor} lets you halt lawbreakers in their tracks. You can use an action to cast the {@spell Web} spell (save DC 13) once per day.

item.name: Hood of Soothing Shadows
entries: The soft darkness beneath its cowl rejuvenates both mind and body.
When you successfully use the {@action Hide} action, you can either restore {@dice 2d8} Hit Points or a level 1 spell slot. You can use this ability once per Short Rest.

item.name: Hushed Magebane
entries: The matte dark wood of this weapon muffles any sound, even when it is loaded and fired.

This {@item +1 Hand Crossbow} can silence its targets. When you hit a target with a bolt from this weapon, you can immediately use a Bonus action to silence the target, preventing the target from casting spells with verbal components until the end of the target's next turn. You can use this ability once per day.

item.name: Infiltrator's Sheath
entries: Made of leather and adorned with a turquoise eye, the edges of this sheath shimmer when seen out of the corner of your eye.

When a one-handed bladed weapon is placed in this sheath, both the sheath and the weapon become {@condition invisible}, as per the spell {@spell Invisibility}. This effect ends once the weapon is drawn. The sheath resizes to the weapon placed in it.

If a creature searching for weapons succeeds at a DC 20 {@skill Perception} or {@skill Investigation} check, they find the {@condition invisible} sheath based on other cues like feeling it or seeing how it affects the wearer's clothing.

item.name: Ironfang
entries: Heavy and unforgiving, it bites through armor, trying to reach that succulent flesh.
This {@item +1 Longsword} can drain the life from your target.

When you successfully hit a target with it, you can use a Bonus action immediately afterward to deal additional Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You gain Hit Points equal to the additional damage dealt this way. Undead and constructs are immune to this effect.

item.name: Occulted Link
entries: Bound by dark magic, this ring turns your veins into a conduit.
Whenever you take damage, you can have your summon, beast companion, or familiar take {@dice 1d8} of that damage instead.

item.name: Motley Coat
entries: A riot of colors and patches hides far more tricks than it reveals.
When an attack roll misses you, deal Psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier to the attacker.

item.name: Necromancer's Rod
entries: The dark wood is warm with the memory of hands that will no longer feel anything but cold.

This weapon acts as a {@item +1 Club}. When you create or take control of undead, that creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your character level. As an action, sacrifice a nearby corpse to give all undead under your control bonuses to attack rolls, damage rolls, and AC equal to your
Proficiency Bonus until the end of your next turn.

item.name: One Stone Bow
entries: This weathered bow remembers the patience of hunters who carried only a single shot worth taking.

When you make a ranged attack with this weapon and hit a target, you can cause the ammunition to ricochet toward a second target within 10 feet of the first. Make a free ranged attack against the second target without expending further ammunition. Each arrow can only ricochet once.

item.name: Oozewarden's Boon
entries: The twisted bogwood is slick with unwholesome moisture, but your grip is adhered to its surface.

This {@item +1 Quarterstaff} makes your acid attacks viscous and sticky. Whenever a target fails a saving throw against a spell dealing Acid damage, the target also suffers -10 Speed until the end of its next turn and takes an additional {@damage 1d4} Acid damage at the start of each of its turns until it leaves its spot.

item.name: Pouch of Smoke Bombs
entries: The faint smell of acrid powder promises a swift and dramatic exit.

This belt pouch contains two smoke bombs. As an action, retrieve a smoke bomb and throw it anywhere you can see within 60 feet. Anything within a 10-foot radius of impact is {@quickref Vision and Light||2||Heavily Obscured} for 1 round and {@quickref Vision and Light||2||Lightly Obscured} for the following round. All creatures caught in the radius must re-roll their Initiative. The pouch replenishes the smoke bombs at dawn.

item.name: Prehensile Whip
entries: Never quite still, the lash coils and twists as it waits for something to occupy it.
This {@item +1 Whip} can be used to perform {@skill Sleight of Hand} checks from 10 feet away. You also gain +2 to Climb checks.

item.name: Primordial Savant Staff
entries: The ancient wood thrums with knowledge older than any spellbook.

This {@item +1 Quarterstaff} grants you the power of elemental forces. Any level 1 or higher spell you cast that does Fire, Poison, Cold, Lightning, or Acid damage can be changed to any of the other three damage types. As long as the last spell damage the target took was of a different type from the type you just chose, roll an additional damage die for your spell.

item.name: Quicksilver Lance
entries: Its shining shaft seems to shift like liquid metal just before the strike.

This weapon acts as a {@item +1 Lance}. If you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can make a free melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

item.name: Reflex Shield
entries: The moment danger strikes, this shield moves faster than thought, interposing itself with uncanny precision.
This Shield grants you a +2 bonus to your AC. You can also cast {@spell Shield} as a Reaction without expending a spell slot once per day.

item.name: Resonant Maul
entries: Each strike hums through stone and bone alike, echoing long after the blow has fallen.

On a hit, this {@item +1 Maul} imposes Disadvantage on the target's checks to maintain {@status Concentration}. Once per day, it can cast {@spell Silence} at its lowest level without expending a spell slot centered on itself.

item.name: Ring of the Deep Shadows
entries: The metal drinks the light around it, as though it remembers darker places than this.
The wearer's weapons and Unarmed Strikes deal an additional {@damage 1d4} damage against targets when attacking from stealth. Gain +2 to {@skill Stealth}.

item.name: Ring of the Shifter
entries: Slender and unassuming, Ring of the Shifter carries magic that reveals itself only when truly needed.
Whenever you are in a form that consumed a Wild Shape charge, gain +2 to AC and +2 to attacks until the form ends.

item.name: Spellweaver's Signet
entries: The ring glows faintly when magic gathers, eager to join the pattern.

This ring allows the wearer to redirect magical energies. When an opponent casts a spell, as a Reaction you can expend a spell slot of the same level to gain Advantage on saving throws to that spell. This item can act as a Spellcasting Focus.

item.name: Smuggler's Duster
entries: Its many hidden seams whisper of secrets that passed quietly through guarded doors.

On command, an interdimensional pocket appears in the lining of this coat that can contain up to 15 lbs of inanimate matter. There is no air inside, so any living being placed inside will die of suffocation if left inside for too long. You can retrieve an item by thinking about which object you want to retrieve. Another command seals the pocket. This item does not appear magical under {@spell Detect Magic}.

item.name: Stormkin Axe
entries: Static prickles along its haft, eager for the swing that will set it loose upon your enemies.

This {@item +1 Battleaxe} also has the {@itemProperty T||Thrown} property (Range 20/60). When thrown, it deals {@dice 1d4} additional Lightning damage to its target and any creature within 5 feet of the thrown axe's direct path. You can command the axe to return to you as a Bonus Action, dealing {@damage 1d4} Lightning damage to any creature within 5 feet of its direct return path to you.

item.name: Suction Pouch
entries: Once something drops inside, the pouch clings to it with a stubbornness bordering on spite.

As an action, you can pick up all Tiny or smaller inanimate objects (coins, ammunition, caltrops, etc.) within 5 feet of you if the Suction Pouch is empty. When used as part of a {@skill Sleight of Hand} check to steal or hide such objects, gain Advantage on that check. You can retrieve one or more items from the Suction Pouch as an action.

item.name: Summoner's Cane
entries: The polished tip taps impatiently, waiting for something from elsewhere to answer.

This weapon acts as a {@item +1 Quarterstaff}. When you are {@status concentration||Concentrating} on a spell, all your summoned creatures gain{@dice  + 1d4} to attack rolls and saving throws as long as you maintain {@status Concentration}.

item.name: Switch Knuckles
entries: A flick of the wrist sends hidden steel snapping into place with a sound that ends conversations.

Gain +1 to attack and damage on your Unarmed Strikes. Your Unarmed Strikes now do your choice of Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage and count as magical for the purposes of overcoming resistance and immunity.

item.name: Sword of Spectacle
entries: Every thrust and riposte demands an audience, and the blade never disappoints.

This {@item +1 Rapier} allows you to roll a {@skill Performance} check when you are hit by an attack. Until the end of your next turn, your AC is equal to the result of that check. You can use this once per day for free or expend a use of Bardic Inspiration to use it an additional time.

item.name: The Rewoven Loop
entries: This endless ring bears the careful stitches of something once broken and mended.

After you have moved on your turn, you can activate the ring as a Bonus Action to teleport back to the location where you started your turn. Your next {@skill Stealth} or {@skill Athletics} check is made with Advantage. Use once per Short Rest.

item.name: The Hidden Hermit's Pocket Closet
entries: A humble ring with a pocket that unfolds into a space far larger than any hermit should reasonably need.

Your Speed increases by 10 feet while Invisible, transformed, or Wild Shaped. Whenever you cast a Transmutation or Illusion spell on yourself, and whenever you Wild Shape into a different form, you can change your items, weapons, and outfit as a free action.

item.name: Z'lethan Guardian Spear
entries: Its bone point has stood vigilant longer than the Z'lethan kingdoms who made it.
This {@item +1 Spear} makes its wielder Immune to the Poisoned condition and Resistant to Poison damage. Once per day, if you fail a saving throw you can retry it once.

item.name: Gloves of the Brute Mage
entries: Heavy and scarred, they prove that even the crudest fists can carry a spark of arcane force.
Your ranged spell attacks can be made as melee spell attacks when you are adjacent to a hostile creature. Your melee spell attacks gain +2 damage.

item.name: Hedge Mage's Stick
entries: Crooked and humble, yet stubbornly effective in practiced hands.

When you are wielding this Wand, you gain Advantage on Initiative checks and your Spell Save DC and Spell Attack Bonus is +2 against {@status surprised} opponents. This item can act as a Spellcasting Focus.

item.name: Inertial Band
entries: The ring grows strangely heavy in motion, as though it resists the very idea of stopping.

When you cast a cantrip, the ring activates until the end of your next turn. While the ring is active, the next time you roll damage for a spell requiring a spell slot, you roll an additional die of damage and the ring deactivates.

item.name: Headband of Quick Wit
entries: A thin band that tightens with every clever thought, urging the mind ever faster.
Your Wisdom is 17 while you wear this headband. It has no effect on you if your Wisdom is already 17 or higher without it. You can also add your Wisdom bonus to Charisma-based skill checks.

item.name: Hunter's Sight
entries: While wearing this helm, you gain the ability to cast {@spell Hunter's Mark} at its lowest level once per day without expending a spell slot. While cast this way, Hunter's Mark doesn't require {@status concentration}. You can dismiss this spell by using a bonus action.

item.name: Palm Blade
entries: Hidden along the hand, its slim edge waits for the moment a handshake becomes something else.

This specialized weapon has the Light and Finesse properties and deals {@damage 1d4} Slashing damage. As a bonus action, you can roll a {@skill Sleight of Hand} check (DC 15) to hide the weapon and gain Advantage on your next attack roll with this weapon.

item.name: Ring of the Divine Battery
entries: Faint sparks ripple across its surface, storing power like a chant waiting to be spoken.

Whenever you make a successful melee weapon attack that deals damage, you may cast one of your level 1 spells this turn as a free acton. That spell must have a healing effect and a casting time of 1 Action.

item.name: Siegebreaker Crossbow
entries: A favorite weapon on the ramparts of besieged fortresses, a never-ending stream of bolts flies forth from this ingenious weapon.
After firing, this {@item Hand Crossbow|PHB} will magically reload itself without consuming an action. Ignore the {@itemProperty LD||Loading} property of this weapon.

item.name: Ring of Aerial Ambush
entries: Light as a falling feather, this ring seems to wait patiently for the moment gravity becomes a weapon.
While wearing this ring, you can cast {@spell Jump} as a Bonus Action once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot, but can target only yourself when you do so.
Until the end of your next round, you ignore fall damage and your next attack has advantage and if it hits, it is a critical hit.

item.name: Sanguine Lens
entries: When you wear this lens, creatures not at full Hit Points do not gain the benefits of Invisibility or obscurement against you.

item.name: Rolling Boulder Band
entries: Once it starts, the power in this ring seems reluctant to stop.
Whenever you successfully hit with a melee attack, your next melee attacks this turn gain +1 to attack and damage.

item.name: Pipe of Knowledge
entries: Its smoke curls into thoughtful spirals, pondering answers just beyond reach.
Add your Proficiency Bonus to all Intelligence-based skill checks when smoking this pipe.

trait.name: Slippery Little Thing
entries: The bogle can move through or occupy the space of any creature that is Medium or larger.

trait.name: Escape Artist
entries: When making a Strength check for an action to break itself (or another creature) free from being {@condition restrained}, it always succeeds.

action.name: Slippery Slap
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) Bludgeoning damage. If the bogle hits a creature with this attack, it becomes slick with grime until the start of the bogle's next turn. During that time, the bogle gains a +2 bonus to AC and saving throws from that creature.

action.name: Hop
entries: The bogle jumps up to 5 feet. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. The hop can be used as part of its action.

spell.name: Poisoned Words
entries: Your words slither into the mind of a creature, planting doubt, confusion, or despair. Choose a creature within range—it must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure,  the target suffers disadvantage on Charisma checks and saving throws for the duration. Immunity to charm negates this effect.

items: At 5th level, the target also suffers disadvantage on attack rolls against you.
At 11th level, the spell's duration extends to 10 minutes.
At 17th level, you can target two creatures at once.

spell.name: Seductive Longing
entries: You plant a fleeting sense of curiosity, infatuation, or trust in the mind of a creature within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or feel an inexplicable urge to approach you. On a failed save, the target must use its next movement to step at least 10 feet closer to you if possible. This spell does not provoke hostility unless the creature was already hostile to you. Charm immunity negates the effect of this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: At 5th level, the target also gains disadvantage on its next Insight check against you.
At 11th level, the target is Charmed until the start of your next turn if it fails its save.
At 17th level, this spell affects all creatures of your choice within 30 feet.

spell.name: Cordon Bleu of Arrows

components.m: six small food items such as bones, carrots, drumsticks, or sausages

entries: You enchant a small feast of improvised "ammunition" to defend a space. You place the food items on the ground within your reach. Until the spell ends, whenever a creature other than you first enters a 30-foot radius centered on the food or ends its turn there, one enchanted piece launches itself at that creature.
The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} piercing damage and {@damage 1d4} poison damage.
The food is then destroyed. The spell ends early when no enchanted food remains.
When you cast the spell, you may designate any number of creatures you choose. Those creatures do not trigger the effect.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you may enchant two additional food items for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Crown of the Bog Lord
entries: A crown of pale ephemeral lilies forms above a willing creature's head. For the Duration:

items: Allies within 10 feet of the crowned creature gain +1 bonus to AC
Enemy creatures start their turn within the aura take {@damage 2d6} psychic damage
The crowned creature can cast {@spell Command} once (no slot or components)

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a slot above 5th, increase the aura's radius by 5 feet and the psychic damage by {@dice 1d6} for each slot above 5th. At 7th level or higher, the crowned creature can cast {@spell Command} twice during the spell's duration.

spell.name: Deezy's Surprise Bolt
entries: You conjure an undulating, cackling mass of goblin energy and hurl it toward one creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d8} damage. Choose one of the d8s. The number it rolled determines the type of damage, as shown below.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the spell deals an extra {@damage 1d8} damage of the rolled type for each slot level above

entriesHigherLevel.name: 2nd.
entries: If four or more d8s show the same number, the bolt becomes an unstoppable vessel of pure goblin energy.
Treat it as if affected by both the Empowered Spell and the Seeking Spell Metamagic feature, even if you don't have it.

spell.name: Dungfire

components.m: a lump of dried dung and a match

entries: You conjure a burst of foul, green-orange flame that burns with infernal stink. Choose a point you can see within range; the fire erupts in a 10-foot-radius sphere.

Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 2d6} fire damage and {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Flammable objects ignite, and the area reeks for 1 minute, imposing disadvantage on {@skill Stealth} checks made to hide there.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the fire or necrotic damage (your choice) increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Fiendish Gobblade

components.m: a drop of your own blood and a goblin's tooth

entries: You summon a massive sword forged from writhing, screaming goblinoid fiends bound together by molten boggart ichor. It hums, swears, and occasionally bites itself.

When you cast this spell, the blade erupts in your grasp (or hovers beside you if you have no hand free). The sword counts as a magic {@item greatsword|PHB} that you are proficient with and that uses your Charisma for attack and damage rolls.
While the spell lasts, you gain the following benefits:

items.name: Writhing Reach
items.entry: The sword has a 5-foot reach as the bound gobbos stretch and claw to hit your foes.

items.name: Gobbo Chorus
items.entry: When you hit a creature with the sword, it takes an additional {@damage 1d8} psychic damage from the gobbos' shrieking. You can add your Charisma modifier to that extra damage once per turn.

items.name: Rebuke of the Brood (1/Turn)
items.entry: When you kill a creature with the sword, as a reaction the gobbos can cheer and bite the nearest enemy within 10 feet of the slain creature. That enemy takes {@damage 1d8} necrotic damage (no action required).

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a slot of 4th level or higher, the psychic and necrotic damage each increase by {@dice 1d8} for every slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Granny's Planar Oven

components.m: a baking stone and ashes from a campfire

entries: You open a portal to an {@condition invisible} oven that radiates unbearable heat.

items: Choose a point within range; a 10-foot cube of air turns into shimmering heat.
Creatures entering or starting their turn there take {@damage 4d8} fire damage.
The area counts as {@quickref Vision and Light||2||lightly obscured} by mirage.
You can move the oven up to 20 ft. as a bonus action each turn.

spell.name: Inner Brood

components.m: a spoon licked clean by a goblinoid creature

entries: Your body sprouts fiendish and goblinoid faces that argue, sing, belch, and sometimes help.

You gain advantage on {@status Concentration} checks, as the faces help you remember and chant your spells. Creatures of your choice within 30ft are heckled by the faces,  and have disadvantage on {@status Concentration} checks.
Once per turn, when you cast a spell that deals damage, you can have the faces echo it, dealing extra damage equal to your Charisma modifier to one target of the spell.

spell.name: Kela's Gobsmack
entries: You deliver a backhanded burst of goblin bravado. Make a melee spell attack; on a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} force damage and must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: Damage increases by {@dice 1d8} at 5th ({@dice 2d8}), 11th ({@dice 3d8}), and 17th ({@dice 4d8}) levels.

spell.name: Nikte's Detrimental Snotsphere

components.m: a cracked bead or a goblin tooth

entries: You conjure a wobbling, semi-transparent sphere of spiteful magic snot centered on a point you can see within range. The sphere has a 10-foot radius and radiates an aura of bad luck, resistance, and goblin resentment.
While the sphere persists, the following effects apply:

items.name: Protective Malice
items.entry: Creatures of your choice inside the sphere gain a +2 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws against attacks (including ranged attacks) originating from outside the sphere.

items.name: Punitive Rebound
items.entry: When a hostile creature outside the sphere hits a creature inside it with an attack or forces it to fail a saving throw, the attacker takes {@damage 2d6} force damage as the magic snaps back at them. A creature can take this damage only once per round.

entries: As a Bonus Action on your turn, you can move the sphere up to 20 feet to a point you can see within range.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the force damage from Punitive Rebound increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Johnathan Inke's Font of Vigor

components.m: enchanted ink used to draw a panther sigil on your skin

entries: You carve Johnathan Inke's Panther Sigil into your flesh using enchanted ink, then brand a creature you can see within range with a flickering necromantic mark. The sigils pulse in tandem, binding your vitality to the creature's suffering. Until the spell ends, the following effects apply:

entries.name: Shared Font
entries: Once per turn, when a creature of your choice hits the marked target with a weapon attack, the attacker regains {@dice 2d4} hit points as necromantic energy siphons vitality from the mark.

entries.name: Coven's Price
entries: While this spell is active, you have disadvantage on Constitution saving throws, and whenever you take damage, you take extra necrotic damage equal to your proficiency bonus as the panther sigil feeds.

entries.name: Witch-Bound Focus
entries: If the marked creature drops to 0 hit points while the spell is active, the sigil flares violently. Until the end of your next turn, you may cast one 1st-level spell you know without expending a spell slot. That spell must have a casting time of 1 action. Once this free spell is cast, Johnathan Inke's Font of Vigor immediately ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the healing from Shared Font increases by {@dice 1d4} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Adhesive Globule
entries: You summon a small glob of a sticky substance and hurl it at a creature within range. Choose one of the following body parts to aim for and make a ranged spell attack roll. On a hit, the target suffers the effects listed for that body part.

items.name: Eyes
items.entry: The target is {@condition blinded}. The attack roll for this effect has a -3 penalty.

items.name: Feet
items.entry: The target's speed is reduced to 0.

items.name: Hands
items.entry: The target may only make a maximum one attack on their turn. This cannot not effect creatures that are Huge or larger.

items.name: Mouth
items.entry: They can neither speak nor satisfy the verbal component for spells. The attack roll for this effect has a -3 penalty.

entries: A creature under one of these effects can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, the effect ends as it frees itself.

default: (a) a {@item hand crossbow|phb} and {@item crossbow bolts (20)|phb|20 bolts} or (b) five {@item javelins|phb

classFeature.name: Daring Defence
entries: Due to the wide variety of dangers you face, you have found the different weights of armors either hamper or aid in your escapades. In addition to the normal bonuses and attributes donning a set of armor provides you, you gain the following benefits and penalties depending on the classification of the set of armor worn.

items.name: Heavy
entries: Reduce any damage you would take by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus. You have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

items.name: Medium
entries: When you are hit by an attack from an attacker you can see, you can use your reaction to halve that attack’s damage against you. Your movement speed also increases by 5 feet.

items.name: Light
entries: You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects you can see and your movement speed increases by 10 feet. You have disadvantage on Constitution saving throws against effects that deal acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage

classFeature.name: Get Into Trouble
entries: Some Genetic Heritages will present optional features such as Genetic Disparity and Genetic Flaws that refer to and modify base class features. Although it is intended that you use such features, it is your choice if you want to include these or not.

classFeature.name: Always a Way Out
entries: At 1st level you start your transformation from human to superhuman with the simplest and most self-sufficient of implants; allowing you to survive your other heart being damaged or destroyed as well as surviving in low oxygen environments. Not just a back-up however, this secondary heart boosts the blood flow around your body.

You gain advantage on Constitution saving throws; it also boosts your movement speed by 5 feet at 1st level, and by an additional 5 feet at 6th, 11th, 16th and 20th levels as shown in the Bonus Movement column of the class table.

classFeature.name: Slippery
entries: At 2nd level, due to rigorous conditioning, through chemical treatment, indoctrination, and hypnotherapy alongside your implants, you gain bonuses to your ability scores each level from 2nd shown in the Ability Score Bonuses columns of the class table. These bonuses can allow your Strength and Constitution ability scores to go higher than 20, however they cannot go higher than 24, and your other ability scores cannot go higher than 20.

classFeature.name: Expert Ventures
entries: At 3rd level, you choose to focus on how you apply your skill. Choose either the Guiding Hand or the Virtuoso venture. Both of these are detailed in the following pages. Your choice grants you features at 3rd level and again at 7th, 10th, 15th, and 20th levels.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: When you reach 4th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.

classFeature.name: Extra Attack
entries: Starting at 5th level, you can attack twice whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

classFeature.name: Improvisation Proficiency (d6)
entries: You are adept at working with whatever tools are at hand to get the job done. When you attack with an improvised weapon, you may use your Proficiency bonus, even  if the object you are attacking with bears no resemblance to a weapon.

In addition the damage dice for using such weapons increases to d6, and increases again to d8 at 9th level, d10 at 13th level, and at 17th level it increases to d12 and is considered to have the light property as long the object being wielded weighs less than 100 pounds.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: When you reach 6th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.

classFeature.name: Venture Feature
entries: At 7th level, you gain one feature granted by your Expert Venture

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: When you reach 8th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.

classFeature.name: Improvisation Proficiency (d8)
entries: When you make an attack with an improvissed weapon, you can use d8 as it's damage die

classFeature.name: Tools at Hand
entries: It goes without saying that being restrained severely limits one’s access to tools. A clever mind finds almost anything can be used to get out of a sticky situation. You may use your Proficiency bonus when using an object that can feasibly fit in a lock in an attempt to pick it.

classFeature.name: Venture Feature
entries: At 10th level, you gain one feature granted by your Expert Venture

classFeature.name: Versatile Defence
entries: Thanks to your extensive experience with a wide variety of equipment, you have further learned to utilize your chosen defenses to maximum effect. You gain the following benefits depending on the classification of armor you are wearing (in addition to the effects of the Daring Defense feature).

items.name: Heavy
entries: You have resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage.

items.name: Medium
entries: When you use a reaction, you gain a +2 bonus to your AC until the end of your next turn.

items.name: Light
entries: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: When you reach 12th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.

classFeature.name: Improvisation Proficiency (d10)
entries: When you make an attack with an improvissed weapon, you can use d10 as it's damage die

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: When you reach 14th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.

classFeature.name: Venture Feature
entries: At 15th level, you gain one feature granted by your Expert Venture

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: When you reach 16th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.

classFeature.name: Improvisation Proficiency (d12, light)
entries: When you make an attack with an improvissed weapon, you can use d12 as it's damage die
Additionally, any improvised weapon that weighs less than 100 pounds counts as a light weapon to you

classFeature.name: Endure to Survive
entries: You have honed not only your skills to escape, but your physicality such that you can survive even the harshest of situations without losing effectiveness. You can hold your breath for up to two hours, do not suffer any penalties to attack rolls or skill checks for being blinded or deafened, only need to eat and drink once every 7 days, only accrue exhaustion for not sleeping after the 7th missed night’s sleep, and do not suffer any penalties for being in an extremely hot or cold environment.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: When you reach 19th level you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
If your DM allows the use of feats, you may instead take a feat.

classFeature.name: Venture Feature
entries: At 20th level, you gain one feature granted by your Expert Venture

subclassFeature.name: Guiding Hand Escapologist
entries: Where some Escapologists hoard their skills for fame and fortune, those that venture down the path of the Guiding Hand seek to utilize their skills to safeguard those around them. Such individuals have not only grown skilled at escaping whatever dangers adventuring presents them, but to also aid their allies in achieving the same feats. Often this takes them further into the line of fire, but their unbreaking nature ensures they can survive even the most disastrous of outcomes.

subclassFeature.name: Mentor's Aid
entries: When a creature or object adjacent to you grapples, incapacitates, paralyzes, restrains, or stuns a single other creature within 60 feet of you, as a reaction you may instead make yourself the target of that effect. You must declare this effect before the opposed check is made.

subclassFeature.name: Learned Luck
entries: Witnesses tell the tale of your incredible luck at surviving the impossible, but you know that luck came from years of hard work and spilled blood. When you make an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw and have disadvantage on the roll, you may instead make that roll without disadvantage. You may use this feature once per short rest.
Starting at 9th level you may use this feature two times per short rest, increasing to three times at 13th level and four times at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Always Wary Escapologist
entries: Danger lurks around every corner, and each shadow hides a menace until it has been proven otherwise. While you are conscious you cannot be surprised and have advantage on Initiative checks. In addition, any {@skill Perception} and {@skill Investigation} skill checks you make to find hidden dangers such as traps or ambushers are made with advantage.

subclassFeature.name: Lead by Example
entries: When you succeed on a saving throw for an ability or effect from a hostile source, you may choose a number of creatures equal to your proficiency bonus that are within 60 feet of you and that can see you to learn from your experience. Those creatures have advantage on the next saving throw they are required to make for that ability or effect. You may use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency modifier and regain all spent uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Bullet Catch
entries: Myths circle through the Escapologist community of an individual who was so swift they could catch a projectile fired via black powder. You have grown in your skill to the point where there are now at least two people who can accomplish this feat. When a creature other than yourself that is within 15 feet of you is targeted by a ranged attack, you may use your reaction to try and catch the projectile. When you do so, you move to be adjacent to the targeted creature. Then, the attacker rolls their attack roll and you must make a Dexterity saving throw with a DC equal to the attack roll’s result.

On a success you catch the projectile harmlessly, and the original target is dealt no damage. If the ranged attack was a ranged spell attack and you succeed on the saving throw, for the next minute your you gain resistance to the damage type that the spell would have dealt.
If you fail the saving throw, you instead become the target of the attack and it automatically hits you.

subclassFeature.name: Mistake's Rebuttal
entries: You have learned to not only aid your allies in escaping the worst fate has to offer, but to actively prevent the worst of a catastrophic moment. As a reaction to a creature you can see being hit by an attack roll, failing a saving throw, or in any other way becoming imminently in danger of being harmed, you may stop the flow of time for all but yourself. No time passes for other creatures, while you take 10 turns in a row (1 minute of time).
During this moment of frozen time you may drag willing creatures that are large or smaller by physically maneuvering them. Your movement speed is reduced by half while dragging creatures this way.

Time continues either after the 1 minute has expired, or if anything you do affects a creature in any way other than moving them. This effect also ends early if you move more than 1,000 feet from where you were when you activated it.

When time resumes, any attack, abilities, spells, or effects that were about to happen before the stop still happen. Creatures may not change the target of these abilities, and any that are invalid due to their target no longer being viable are wasted. Area of effects still occur with the originally chosen source point  after time resumes. Once you use this feature you may not use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Virtuoso Escapologist
entries: Not all performers of escapology make the transition to adventuring, but those that do retain the focus on performance first and foremost, along with the many tricks they learned from their stagecraft. In turn the exhilaration of their daring feats inspires their party, reminds them of the wonder of the adventure they are embarked upon and the magic of their actions.

subclassFeature.name: Give Them A Show
entries: When you escape from being grappled by a hostile creature or incapacitated, paralyzed, or restrained by any creature, you may give Awestruck Inspiration to each creature of your choosing that can see you and is within 60 feet of you. Awestruck Inspiration gained this way lasts for 1 minute.

A creature with Awestruck Inspiration can spend it when they make an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw to roll a d6 and add the result to that roll. A creature can only have Awestruck Inspiration or not, it is not a resource that can be stockpiled.
You may use this ability a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier to a minimum of 1. You regain expended uses when you finish a short or long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Nothing Up My Sleeve
entries: Many times the key to escaping is simply hiding the right tool in the right place. You have grown adept at sequestering the items you need within folds of clothing, the corners of your mouth, or other more imaginative places. While clothed you may have up to 8 tiny items hidden about your body. While unclothed you may have up to 3 tiny items hidden.

Tiny items include things like Thieves’ Tools, a potion bottle, key, or anything else at the GM’s discretion. You have access to these items regardless of whether you are restrained, so long as you are conscious.
Any creature that searches you for hidden items does so with disadvantage.

subclassFeature.name: The Magic Touch
entries: While it is traditional that escapology does not utilize real magic, no one is strictly stopping you. And besides, it would be a shame to leave so much potential for pizzazz on the table. You learn the Mage Hand, Prestidigitation, and Thaumaturgy cantrips. Your mage hand is always conjured invisible. You may use your mage hand to perform the following additional tasks:

items: Stow or retrieve an item on your person
Use thieves’ tools to pick a lock
Use a key to open a lock

subclassFeature.name: Now You See Me
entries: It is not enough to merely escape, for appearing unexpectedly adds all the more dazzle to the feat. When you escape from being grappled, incapacitated, paralyzed, or restrained by a hostile creature, you may teleport to an unoccupied space up to 30 feet away.

subclassFeature.name: Smoke And Mirrors
entries: Sometimes the best way to escape from danger is to never be caught at all. An expert performer leads the eye where they want, and makes the audience believe the impossible is real. When you fail either a saving throw or a contested skill check, or are hit by an attack, as a reaction you may become invisible and teleport up to 30 feet away. You become visible after 1 minute, when you make an attack or cast a spell, or end the effect on your turn.

When you do so you leave behind a semi-tangible illusory duplicate of yourself. The duplicate vanishes when you become visible. The duplicate has enough physicality that it can be picked up, grappled, restrained and so on, but is revealed to be an illusion when it takes damage. You may control the actions and expressions of this duplicate. The duplicate is silent and you may not move it. It also may not attack or attempt to deal damage in any way. A creature may see through the duplicate’s illusory nature by making a contested {@skill Investigation} check against your {@skill Deception} skill.
You may use this twice. You regain expended uses of this feature when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Infallible Skill
entries: Long practiced, and much survived, your skills have grown to the point that failure by your own hand is no longer a possibility. You may choose to automatically succeed on Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throws. If an effect that requires a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw would deal half damage on a success, you instead take no damage from that effect. You may use this ability a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier, to a minimum of 1. You regain all spent uses when you finish a short or long rest.
